title: Knowledge Area v1 Schema
description: A schema for defining a Knowledge Area (KA) from the CS2023 curriculum.

name.description: The full name of the Knowledge Area (e.g., 'Software Engineering').

code.description: The official abbreviation for the KA (e.g., 'SE').

description.description: A high-level description of the Knowledge Area.

title.description: The title of the section (e.g., 'SE/Software Processes').

content_as_text.description: The full content of the section, including bullet points and outcomes, as a single block of plain text.
